posts.title: A MacOS port of reptyr
posts.description: Reptyr is a tool that lets you reparent a running program to a new terminal. For example, if you have a Slurm job running but you forgot to run it on a tmux pane, ur screwed. Reptyr helps sidestep this by letting you 'move' the terminal process into a tmux session, allowing you to detach safely.
